messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Carvedilol is a beta-blocker. Beta-blockers affect the heart and circulation (blood flow through arteries and veins).
Carvedilol is used to treat heart failure and hypertension (high blood pressure). It is also used after a heart attack that has caused your heart not to pump as well.
Carvedilol may also be used for purposes not listed in this medication guide.
Carvedilol is not approved for use by anyone younger than 18 years of age.
Triplet: ["Carvedilol", "may be used for", "unlisted purposes"]

The relation 'may be used for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug can be utilized for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity, though it may not be explicitly listed in official documentation.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has off label use': The subject drug is used for purposes not specifically approved or listed in the official medication guide, as specified by the object entity.
B. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
D. 'used in': The subject drug is utilized in the medical procedure or clinical context specified by the object entity.
E. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
